title: sarcopodium coelogyne
intro: Sarcopodium coelogyne, commonly known as Coelogyne, is a genus of orchids that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its fragrant flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Coelogyne include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Coelogyne include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, anti-oxidation, and anti-allergic effects.
